title: Battery Life Calculator
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Battery Life
Current Draw
Low Power Design
Sleep Mode
description: Interactive Chart.js battery life calculator. Students include parts, set backlight brightness, time asleep and battery capacity, see each part's average current in a stacked bar, and compare runtime before and after their changes.

educational.topic: Estimating battery runtime from current draw
learningObjectives: Calculate a clock's average current and estimated runtime from its parts
Evaluate which single design change saves the most energy
Justify a low-power design using numbers rather than guesses
prerequisites: Current in mA and capacity in mAh
The current draw table in Chapter 18

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: What-if comparison with a saved baseline
keyQuestions: Which part draws the most current in the worked example?
Why does sleeping 90% of the time save so much?
Is a bigger battery or a dimmer backlight the better change?
commonMisconceptions: The microcontroller is always the biggest power user (displays and radios often use more)
A battery delivers its full labeled capacity (the 0.8 factor allows for losses)
assessmentOpportunities: Hand-calculate the runtime for a given design
Rank design changes by the runtime they add
Meet a runtime target and explain the design
